snippet.title: Prince of Tennis: Form the Strongest Team! All Characters [PS2]
snippet.description:
Prince of Tennis: Form the Strongest Team! (テニスの王子様最強チームを結成せよ！) - All Characters / Character Select Showcase for PlayStation 2 (PS2).
Explore the full character selection menu and complete player roster in Prince of Tennis: Form the Strongest Team! for the PS2. Watch all tennis players, teams, and unlockable characters in high-quality video showcase!
